snippet.description:
Apple App Store: https://apple.co/4iBIwFi
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.innopede.Filltopia

Filltopia - Divide, Fill & Win
The game app for iPhone, iPad and Android! 
Are you ready to master the ultimate puzzle adventure?
Filltopia challenges your mind with strategic gameplay, stunning visuals, and endless fun. 
Key Features:
- Divide, Fill & Win: Strategically place walls to claim territory and outsmart your opponents.
- Endless Challenges: Tackle over 99 handcrafted levels and additionally countless computer-generated levels
- Explosive Fun: Encounter unpredictable obstacles like walking bombs, flying mines, and nasty UFOs for a thrilling experience.
- Multiplayer Mayhem: On one device, play with up-to 4 friends or compete against AI

How to play?
-Divide: Tap a green trigger button to extend a wall to the next obstacle on the game field.
- Fill: The area divided by the wall will be automatically filled with your player’s color. Now it’s the next players turn.
- Win: At the end of the game, the player with the largest area in their color wins.

Filltopia: The addictive puzzle game that puts your brain to the test. Can you outsmart your opponents and claim the biggest territory?
